text.setup: Stand tall, a dumbbell in each hand resting on the front of your thighs, a small bend in the elbows.
cues: Raise your arms forward with the elbows soft and fixed.
Stop at shoulder height — hands about level with your eyes at most.
Lower slowly back to your thighs.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the weight up.
Bending the elbows more to make it easier.

variants.barbell: Hands shoulder-width on the bar; both arms have to move together.
variants.cable: Face away from a low pulley, the cable between your legs; tension stays on at the bottom.
variants.plate: Hold the plate at the sides like a steering wheel.
variants.resistance_band: Stand on the band; it gets harder the higher you go.
